Subject: Executive presence for Redwood demo — VP + CIO ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. BlueBrick's CIO (Rajiv Patel) and VP of Data (Aisha Khan) are keen to see a brief exec-focused demo next week but their windows are tight. Two constraints: Rajiv can do only short morning blocks (30–45 min) and he prefers only one SLT member from vendor side (VP/Head) attend the sync. Aisha is flexible and can join if it's useful.

Can you propose two narrow windows (30 or 45 minutes) and confirm whether Redwood would object to recording the session? Procurement wants a recording for internal review. Also, do you have a short agenda we can circulate?

If helpful, you can book directly here: https://calendly.com/emmaliu/bluebrick-briefing

Thanks — Emma
Emma Liu

Hi Emma — great to hear Rajiv is available.

We can absolutely keep this to a 30–45 minute executive briefing. Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 13, 08:30–09:00
- Wed Jun 14, 09:00–09:45

Attendees from Redwood (proposed):
- Marissa Cole — VP, Sales (will be the single SLT presence)
- Kimberly Park — Solutions Engineer (technical coverage, short walkthrough)
- Logan Wright — Account Executive (moderator)

Recording is fine; we routinely record exec briefings for procurement. If you'd prefer a no-recording option, we can mark that.

Attached a slim deck (3 slides) focused on exec-level value and a proposed 30-minute run-of-show:
1) 5 min — introductions & business context
2) 10 min — high-level demo (Marissa)
3) 10 min — Q&A + next steps

If neither window works, tell me Rajiv's exact blockers and we'll pivot.

Best,
Logan

We can do Tue Jun 13, 07:45–08:15 PST. Marissa will join as the single SLT attendee; Kimberly will cover technical. Per procurement's request, here's a short recording/data-retention statement we will read at the start and include in the meeting notes: 

"Redwood Inference records this executive briefing only for internal evaluation and procurement purposes. Session recording and associated artifacts (slides, logs) are retained for 90 days and may be accessed by the account team and security/compliance personnel. Recordings are not shared externally without explicit customer consent and are deleted earlier on request."

Next steps:
- I've sent a calendar invite for Tue Jun 13, 07:45–08:15 PST (please accept)
- Attached deck is the 3-slide executive view; Marissa will open with a 7-minute overview.
- Kimberly will include a single slide on security/compliance (short bullet points) and be prepared for a 10-minute Q&A.

If you prefer a no-recording alternative, let me know and we'll honor that — otherwise we'll record and include the retention statement at the top.

See you Tuesday — Logan
